subject: Milestone invoicing & PO acknowledgement window — options and next steps
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Milestone invoicing: PO ack window and net terms?

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups before we can route the SOW for signature:

- Can Redwood accept milestone-triggered invoices (one invoice per milestone deliverable) versus a single monthly consolidated invoice?
- What is your required window for PO acknowledgement? Our internal system expects POs to be acknowledged within 45 days of issuance — will that be an issue?
- Standard net terms here are Net45. Do you have flexibility (Net30 vs Net45) and would different terms change pricing/discounts?

I've attached the current SOW we discussed (Master_SOW_v3.pdf). Please advise what you need from our side to keep things moving.

Appreciate it,
Lydia Chen
Head of Procurement — Acme Corp
lydia.chen@acme.com

Attachments: Master_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Milestone invoicing: PO ack window and net terms?

Hi Lydia — thanks, and great to meet you earlier. Short answers first, then proposed options so procurement can pick the path that fits Acme's internal cadence.

Standards at a glance:
- PO requirement: We require a PO number on every invoice. For milestone invoicing we accept a PO per invoice or a master PO referencing the contract id.
- PO acknowledgement: Our standard operational window for acknowledging a PO is 30 days. We can extend to 45 days for enterprise customers with an agreed process and a listed billing contact to expedite acknowledgements.
- Net terms: Redwood's default is Net30 for Hosted usage. Net45 can be approved but typically requires a finance review and sometimes a credit reference or a payment commitment.

Options to consider (pick one):
1) Consolidated monthly invoice (recommended):
   - We issue one invoice per month, itemized by milestone/date.
   - Requires one active PO (master PO) referencing the contract; payment Net45 can be accommodated after finance approval.
   - Advantage: simpler ERP mapping on your side.
2) Per-milestone invoices:
   - We issue an invoice each time a milestone is accepted.
   - We need either a PO per invoice or a master PO with line references.
   - Net terms default to Net30 unless Finance approves Net45, and discounts for Net45 are evaluated.
3) Milestone with holdback (compromise):
   - 90% invoiced on milestone acceptance, 10% retained until final acceptance/QA.
   - Allows shorter payment windows on the bulk and retains leverage for final closure.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (sample PO format and invoice example).

Next steps I recommend:
- Please confirm which option works best for Acme.
- If Net45 is required, share a procurement contact and we will loop in Finance for a quick credit/terms review.
- If you need an official DocuSign SOW, we can send that once the invoicing cadence is agreed.

I'll leave Vanessa and Priyom on the thread to weigh in on discounts or operational constraints.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Milestone invoicing: PO ack window and net terms?

Hi Lydia — looping in Finance. A few things from our side that will influence the final commercial:

1) Discounting is typically tied to one of the following levers:
   - Prepay / upfront commitment (12 months or more)
   - Minimum committed spend band (e.g., $X/month – we can discuss thresholds)
   - Faster payment terms (Net30 vs Net45)

2) If Acme requires Net45 AND milestone-by-milestone invoices, we would normally ask for either:
   - A small annual commitment (so we have predictability), or
   - A partial prepayment for the first quarter, after which terms can move to Net45.

3) Practical recommendation: to avoid extra ERP work and reduce accounting friction, choose the consolidated monthly invoice with itemized milestones. We can approve Net45 for that path faster.

I'll attach a short memo with examples of pricing impacts by term (finance_memo.pdf). If you can share an expected monthly consumption estimate, we can run a quick model and propose a discount band.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: finance_memo.pdf
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Milestone invoicing: PO ack window and net terms?

Thanks Vanessa — that's helpful. A few clarifications from procurement here: 

- Our legal team prefers milestone invoices tied to acceptance dates (helps match cost to delivery).
- Our AP system is rigid: PO acknowledgements can take up to 45 days for new vendors.

Proposed compromise from Acme:
1) We accept the consolidated monthly invoice for ongoing usage (production bills).
2) For project milestones (professional services), we'd like per-milestone invoices.
3) For the first two invoices (to get the project started), we can do Net30; after Q1, switch to Net45 once internal vendor references are in place.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a sample milestone invoice layout (itemized per deliverable and acceptance criteria), and 2) a DocuSign link for the SOW so legal can start their routing?

I've attached our PO template for reference (Acme_PO_Template.docx). Also — any discount for agreeing to a 12-month minimum committed usage?

Regards,
Lydia Chen
Head of Procurement — Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_PO_Template.docx
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Milestone invoicing: PO ack window and net terms?

Thanks — this is a solid compromise and workable. Summary and next steps (so everyone has clear owners):

Agreed commercial path:
- Production / hosted usage: consolidated monthly invoice, Net45 (pending quick finance check).
- Professional services / project milestones: per-milestone invoices, with the first two invoices on Net30, then move to Net45 after Q1 (assuming no exceptions).
- PO acknowledgement: Redwood will accept 45-day acknowledgement for enterprise customers if Acme provides a named billing contact and uses the supplied PO template.

Action items:
- Rafael: Send sample milestone invoice layout + invoice itemization spreadsheet (attached: Sample_Invoice_Itemization.xlsx).
- Rafael: Send DocuSign SOW link for signature today (DocuSign link included in related_links).
- Vanessa & Finance: Run the quick discount model for a 12-month committed usage band and respond by EOD 10/15.
- Lydia: Confirm billing contact and confirm you received the sample invoice.

Quoting your note below for context:
> Our AP system is rigid: PO acknowledgements can take up to 45 days for new vendors.

I'll loop back once Vanessa confirms the discount band. Appreciate the flexibility on both sides.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
